content.short: RARA is a social curation protocol open to anyone wishing to curate NFTs with friends.
content.description: RARA is a social curation protocol that runs on the Polygon L2 network. By design, curation becomes a way to add social context to NFTs, achieved by burning NFT-based reactions on individual NFTs to attach meaning and discussion to the artwork. The combination of the curated NFT’s media and each Reaction creates a diverse media graph that captures how society connects and values its most cherished NFTs. RARA welcomes anyone who wants to curate NFTs with others, inviting collaborative exploration of digital ownership, culture, and collective taste.
